## What This Course Covers

We work through *Understanding Deep Learning* from the ground up: shallow and
deep networks, how they are trained, how to tell whether they work, and then the
architectures that define the modern field — convolutional networks,
transformers and language models, graph neural networks, and generative models
including VAEs, GANs, and diffusion.

Every topic pairs the mathematics with a working PyTorch implementation. You
will finish the semester having built and evaluated a deep learning system on a
problem you chose yourself.

## Software Setup

All coursework uses Python with PyTorch. You have two options.

**Google Colab** — nothing to install, works in the browser, free GPUs. This is
fine for every assignment in the course.

**Local install** — clone the repository and create an environment:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/harunpirim/IMSE774-NeuralNetworks.git
cd IMSE774-NeuralNetworks
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
